root_causes: Inherited resolver rejected any redirect away from news.google.com without retaining its target. Older errors therefore do not establish whether the target was a publisher or an anti-automation page. Resolver now captures redirect metadata without fetching the target.
Google News metadata endpoint began redirecting to google.com/sorry anti-automation challenge after more than 1,000 metadata lookups; some requests returned HTTP503.
resolution: Stopped repeated network retries; finalized remaining date from available metadata with every unresolved priority Reuters record conservatively excluded. All broad RSS query windows had already succeeded. Frozen feeds preserved.
limits: Cached HTTP503 errors do not retain response bodies, so origin-vs-proxy cause of those individual 503s is not established. Google anti-automation redirect is directly observed.
